北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京有雾且寒冷，出行请注意交通安全，保暖防寒！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is foggy and cold. Please be careful on the road, stay warm and prevent frostbite!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阳光正好，体感舒适。可以外出走走，享受暖意！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi has pleasant sunshine and comfortable temperatures. Go out and enjoy the warmth!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海晴朗宜人，气温适中。穿件薄外套，享受好天气吧。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is sunny and pleasant, with moderate temperatures. Grab a light jacket and enjoy the nice weather.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阳光明媚，略显潮湿。保持室内通风，心情也舒畅。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is sunny and a bit humid. Keep your home ventilated and enjoy a comfortable mood.

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阳光正好，气温舒适。适合户外活动，别忘防晒哦！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen enjoys pleasant sunshine and comfortable temperatures. It's great for outdoor activities, don't forget sun protection!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州晴朗，体感微凉。出门添件衣服，别着凉了呀。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is sunny and feels a bit cool. Add a layer when you go out to avoid catching a cold.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阳光虽好，气温偏低。记得多穿些，注意防寒保暖哦。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is sunny but cool. Remember to dress warmly to protect against the cold.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都多云且湿冷。穿暖些，喝杯热茶，暖暖身心。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy and damp-cold. Dress warmly, enjoy a hot tea, and warm up your body and mind.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉阳光明媚，但体感微凉。早晚温差大，注意添减衣物。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is sunny but feels a bit cool. There's a big temperature difference between morning and evening, so adjust your clothes accordingly.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安晴朗干燥，注意补水保湿。多喝温水，保持舒适哦。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is sunny and dry. Remember to hydrate and moisturize. Drink more warm water to stay comfortable.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆有霾且潮湿，请减少户外活动，注意防护，保护呼吸道。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is hazy and humid. Please limit outdoor activities, take precautions, and protect your respiratory system.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨极寒有雾，务必多穿，小心路滑，安全第一！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is extremely cold and foggy. Be sure to dress warmly, watch for slippery roads, and stay safe!
哈尔滨.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -29℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳阴冷，体感寒凉。多穿厚衣，小心防寒，保持温暖。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is cloudy and cold. Wear warm layers, protect against the cold, and stay cozy.

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阳光正好，体感稍凉。早晚记得添衣，小心别着凉。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming has pleasant sunshine but feels a bit cool. Remember to add layers in the morning and evening to avoid catching a cold.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门阳光明媚，气温宜人。适合出门散步，享受海风。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is sunny with pleasant temperatures. Perfect for a walk, enjoy the sea breeze.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛有雾且风力大，体感冷。出行注意安全，多穿防风衣物。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is foggy and windy, feeling cold. Be careful when out, wear windproof clothing.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连有雾且潮湿阴冷。请多穿衣物保暖，出行注意安全哦。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is foggy, humid, and cold. Please dress warmly to stay warm, and be careful when out.
